messages:
rachel: Heads-up from onboarding this morning: the .NET sample app (grpc transport) prints raw emails and partial tokens in Exception.ToString() when retry logic bubbles an auth error. Repro on dotnet-sdk v0.5.0 with RW_LOG_LEVEL=Debug.

igor: ouch. Serilog's exception destructuring ends up serializing exception.Data and stack with message that includes the email. the sanitizer we ship only hooks Request/Response middleware, not exception formatting.

mei: additionally, gRPC streaming handlers (server-side streaming) don't get the `rw.request_id` Activity tag. we set the header for unary calls but the streaming interceptor wasn't wired. that breaks trace->log correlation for long-lived streams.

sam: thanks for reporting. two parallel asks: (A) prevent PII leak in logs/exceptions across SDKs, and (B) ensure request_id propagation for all transports (http/grpc/ws/stream/lambda).

rachel: quick repro line (redacted locally):
[Error] AuthRetry id=req-204 user=pat.j@company.com token=eyJhbGciOi... stack=AuthRetryException

igor: root cause: in dotnet we rely on Serilog's Rendered compact JSON sink which calls Exception.ToString() before our pipeline-level sanitizer. fix = add a logging enrich/wrapping sink that sanitizes message + exception object before serialize. also sanitize Exception.Data and any IDictionary entries.

mei: for gRPC we need a streaming interceptor that extracts `x-rw-request-id` from Metadata on stream start and sets Activity.Current?.SetTag("rw.request_id", id). also add connection-level propagation for long poll sockets.

sam: I'd like to make this cross-SDK: create a short Telemetry Compatibility Spec that lists: default redact patterns, request_id header name, otel attribute key (rw.request_id), default log level for sample apps, and a recommended logger integration pattern per language. SDK maintainers can implement to ensure parity.

rachel: love that. minimal spec proposal:
```
- redact_defaults: [email, jwt, ssn, credit_card]
- request_id_header: x-rw-request-id
- otel_request_id_key: rw.request_id
- sampleapp_default_log_level: info
- demo_safe_env: RW_SAFE_DEMO=true (enforces INFO + auto-redact)
```

igor: technical notes for dotnet fix: implement an ILogEventEnricher that runs sanitizer on LogEvent.MessageTemplate and LogEvent.Exception before sinks. add unit that calls sink with a fake Exception whose Data contains email and assert serialized output contains "[REDACTED]".

mei: and add a gRPC streaming integration test that: (1) opens a server-stream, (2) triggers an auth retry that fails, (3) captures logs and traces, (4) asserts no email/jwt regex in logs and that Activity has tag rw.request_id.

sam: also propose a small CI telemetry harness in repo_sdk_tests that can run a language-specific sample app, toggle RW_SAFE_DEMO, and assert no PII patterns in logs for INFO/ERROR. This will catch accidental regressions.

rachel: security ask: add a short fuzz test that generates random auth error messages and ensures sanitizer strips emails/JWT-looking tokens from any string output. that helps catch weird nesting cases.

security-bot: created ticket RW-PII-909: "dotnet-sdk: logging sanitizer + grpc request_id propagation" assigned to igor/rachel, label=PII, security-review required

sam: plan: (1) implement logger-enricher in dotnet sdk, (2) add grpc streaming interceptor to set rw.request_id, (3) add tests (unit, integration, fuzz), (4) add telemetry compatibility spec file in /telemetry/spec.md and link in README, and (5) CI harness job. target: patch release in 5 days.

igor: will open small PR with logger-enricher + unit tests today. cc @mei for grpc tests.

mei: can review the gRPC test change. I'll add the streaming interceptor and an integration that asserts Activity tag exists. also will add the sampleapp README note: set RW_SAFE_DEMO=true for demos.

rachel: thanks. once merged i'll run an onboarding demo locally to confirm. please ping security for quick sign-off.

sam: assigning reviewers. appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
